Hi all — answering the Lumenware questions below; I’m keeping the responses concise so we can paste them into the SSQ workbook. I’ve also uploaded two artifacts to the Drive link in this thread: 1) KMS-Rotation-Policy-Excerpt.pdf, 2) LLM-Proxy-Pseudonymization-diagram.pdf (sanitized). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-lumenware-ssq-evidence

1) PII tagging:
- At ingress we run deterministic field-level tagging for common structured fields (emails, SSNs, phone numbers) and heuristic NLP tagging for free-text via a classification pipeline. Both tags are stored as metadata (non-sensitive) associated with the request id, not embedded in model inputs.
- For inference outputs we apply post-processing heuristics to detect exposed identifiers; any match flags a retention-minimization path that redacts the token(s) before telemetry persists.

2) Extraction / pseudonymization (LLM proxy):
- The LLM proxy performs deterministic pseudonymization for configured identifier families. The reversible map is stored in an internal vault-backed key-value store that is encrypted with a KMS customer key in Private deployments or our service key in Hosted.
- Reversibility policy: by default reversible maps are retained for 30 days for debugging; for regulated customers we can configure zero-reversibility (one-way tokenization).
- Audit logs: access to the reversible map is logged and requires mfa + RBAC role ("debug-access"). We can provide a sanitized audit sample.

3) KMS custody & escrow:
- Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) in Private deployments and Dedicated with VPC egress. Our KMS rotation policy rotates service keys quarterly; rotation artifacts and KMS-policy excerpts are in the Drive link.
- Escrow: we do not hold a copy of customer private keys. For archival escrow requests we offer an HSM-backed split custody option under contract (requires procurement approval).

4) Telemetry redaction / retention:
- Default telemetry retention: prompt+response hashes kept 90 days, aggregated usage metrics 365 days. Raw prompts with detected PII are redacted prior to persistence; redaction tokens are reversible only under the reversible map policy described above.
- We can provide a Data Minimization Exhibit (short statement) for the SSQ.

Artifacts I attached to the Drive folder: KMS-Rotation-Policy-Excerpt.pdf, Data-Minimization-Exhibit.txt, LLM-Proxy-Pseudonymization-diagram.pdf.

If Lumenware needs a stricter timeline (e.g., zero-reversibility + BYOK), procurement will need to sign the addendum — Marissa, can you scope the procurement path and an estimated lead time?

— Kimberly
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
